name: pam_umask
detailed_description: Session environment module that sets the default file creation mask (umask) for user sessions. Allows per-user umask configuration to control default file/directory permissions. Configurable via pam_env.conf or direct parameters.
notes:
Sets default file creation mask for user sessions
